category_title: Preschoolers who struggle with sharing objects during collaborative tasks
scenario_title: Collaborative building task during center time
minimal_context: Darin and a friend are using different materials to build a castle together during a 10-minute center time activity.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Darin and Alex, please use these different materials to build a castle together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Takes blocks from Alex's pile) Give me that.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alex is asking for a block to help build.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Remember to share your materials so you can finish the castle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hides the blocks behind his back) That's mine!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Darin and Alex, please use these different materials to build a castle together.

STUDENT: (Takes blocks from Alex's pile) Give me that.

TUTOR: Alex is asking for a block to help build.

STUDENT: I had that first.

TUTOR: Remember to share your materials so you can finish the castle.

STUDENT: (Hides the blocks behind his back) That's mine!

task.content: accomplish a common goal (e.g., building something, creating something)
task.learning_goal: politely share his objects with a friend when asked and/or offer objects to his friend

context.environment: 10-min center time activity in the preschool classroom

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: when the friend makes a request
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: not giving an object when the friend makes a request

behavior_patterns.condition: When Darin and a friend are given different materials and asked to accomplish a common goal
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: does not share throughout the entire two minute interval and may be observed taking the friends’ objects, hiding objects behind his back
